python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[9:21, [0, 2]].dropna(subset=[2])
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Amount']
by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()

print('-'*30)
print('Total Expenses:', by_cat.sum())

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Expense rows: C11:C22 -> 0-based rows 10..21
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 2]].dropna(subset=[2])
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Amount']
by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
print(by_cat.to_string())
print('-'*30)
print('Total Expenses:', by_cat.sum())
print()
print('Matches SUM(C11:C22)? ->', by_cat.sum() == 4200)
"
